adjudication.rationale: In `TopicEmbed.import`, when `embed.blank?` it calls `creator = PostCreator.new(...); post = creator.create` and only creates the `TopicEmbed` row if `post.present?`; if `create` returns nil, the method just returns nil with no logging or failure marker (no rescue/log/flag) (`app/models/topic_embed.rb`, around the transaction). In `EmbedController#best`, when `TopicEmbed.topic_id_for_embed(embed_url)` is nil it enqueues `Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ...)` and renders `loading` (`app/controllers/embed_controller.rb`), whose JS forces a reload every 30s (`app/views/embed/loading.html.erb`). This combination can produce an endless “loading” state and repeated job enqueues per page reload/request when the import keeps failing, with no visible error state.
